policy: Summaries are original research notes, not reproduced source text. Distinguish fictional continuity, living beliefs, scholarship and legal jurisdiction. No automatic doctrinal adoption.

entries.title: Jedi Order
entries.note: Republic-era peacekeepers; study institutional responsibility and its limitations.

entries.title: Sith
entries.note: Fictional dark-side order pursuing power; distinguish its conduct from Knightfall's living interpretation.

entries.title: Jedi holocron
entries.note: Force-accessed archive preserving teachings across generations.

entries.title: Sith holocron
entries.note: Dark-side archive; study its role in Rebels and the Malachor narrative.

entries.title: Lightsaber
entries.note: Fictional kyber-powered instrument; examine symbolism and narrative uses.

entries.title: Temple of the Jedi Order doctrine
entries.note: Primary source for one organization's religious beliefs and ethical framework.

entries.title: Temple of the Jedi training
entries.note: Separate organization describing staged learning, practical assessment and mentorship.

entries.title: Markus Altena Davidsen: The Jedi Community
entries.note: Academic history of Jedi identity, online origins and distinctions between Jediist and Jedi Realist approaches.

entries.title: UK Charity Commission decision
entries.note: 2016 decision concerning a particular charity application; not a universal ruling on Jediism.

entries.title: Lucasfilm 2014 continuity announcement
entries.note: Primary editorial source for the Legends transition; do not infer continuity solely from publication date.

entries.title: Darth Bane
entries.note: Established the Rule of Two in fictional Sith history; examine institutional rivalry and succession.

entries.title: Moraband
entries.note: Ancient Sith world and burial monuments; appears in The Clone Wars.

entries.title: Exegol
entries.note: Ancient Sith world in the Unknown Regions, associated with the Sith Eternal.

entries.title: Stoicism
entries.note: Study virtue, judgment and the interconnected fields of ethics, logic and physics; compare without asserting equivalence to Jediism.

entries.title: Nietzsche: self-fashioning and will to power
entries.note: Distinguish competing readings of power, self-creation and moral criticism. Knightfall applications are interpretations, not Nietzsche's own religious doctrine.

entries.title: Comparative Chinese and Western philosophy
entries.note: Compare Daoist responsiveness, Buddhist critiques of fixed selfhood and Nietzschean individuality without collapsing their differences.

entries.title: Nightsisters
entries.note: Dathomirian magical tradition distinct from the Jedi and Sith. Compare its fictional institutional independence and appearances in The Clone Wars and Ahsoka.
